info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Account Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Account Management Update API enables the modification of existing account management records based on specified parameters. This endpoint allows for a targeted update of product combinations tied to a unique identifier, ensuring that financial institutions can adapt their offerings quickly and efficiently. Typical consumers include bank operators and financial service providers who require real-time adjustments to account configurations. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance user experience and maintain competitiveness in the financial sector.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific product combination identified by its unique ID. Provide the required fields in the request body to modify its properties.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the product combination identified by the unique product code 'PROD-700045'. It contains the fields necessary to define the updates to be made to the existing product combination.
